ontology._layer: Layer 0 — Ontology. 25 entities in entities[] (unambiguously spec-named nouns without a Step-1 halt condition). 6 in entity_implied_but_unnamed.flags[] (Architect stamps inline: Bucket, MetricSnapshot, Split, Session, ExperimentConfig, Source). The four Layer-6-forward placeholders (IngestionClient, AlignmentJoin, TrainingLoop, Simulator) moved to BLACKBOARD § Deferred, folded into P-015's Step-7 commitment — one uniform mechanism for forward-commitments across layer boundaries. Three merges pending in signals/proposals.json — Model is the target of P-001, Prediction of P-002, CostCalibration of P-003; entries below reflect the post-merge shape.

entities.name: Bar
entities.definition: One 15-minute OHLCV observation on the canonical UTC grid for any Symbol; the target instrument produces target bars, the cross-asset context Symbols (QQQ, IWM, VIX, TLT, DXY, GLD, USO) produce context bars, both types share the same schema and grid.
entities.source: product-spec-v4.md §'Why 15-minute'; tech-arch-v4.md §5 'each session yields 26 bars (6.5 hours × 4 bars/hour)'; §4.2 channel table listing 15-min bars for target + market_context Symbols; definition broadening: reviews/vocab-0.1-round-3-review.md finding 7.

entities.name: Symbol
entities.definition: A market instrument identifier (SPY, QQQ, VIX, TLT, ...) a channel fetcher requests from a source; a runtime parameter, never hardcoded in `src/`.
entities.source: product-spec-v4.md §'No hardcoded target instrument'; tech-arch-v4.md invariant #7.

entities.name: Channel
entities.definition: A categorical grouping of data streams contributing features at every timestep: target, market_context, macro, options, event.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §4.2 table 'target / market_context / macro / options / event'.

entities.name: SessionBoundary
entities.definition: The join between one Session's last bar and the next Session's first bar; marked at bar level by `is_overnight_gap`.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §6 'Session-boundary handling'; product-spec-v4.md §'Channels tokenized at every 15-minute timestep' (`is_overnight_gap`).

entities.name: RawObservation
entities.definition: One vendor-native row written to `data/raw/` carrying value_time, released_at, known_at, and (where applicable) revision_id — the four-column schema that makes causality a data-model property.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §4.3 'Every raw observation written to data/raw/ carries four columns'.

entities.name: Revision
entities.definition: A restated version of a previously-published value; each revision writes a new row with a monotone revision_id within (source, channel, symbol, value_time).
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §4.3 'each revision writes a new row with a new revision_id'.

entities.name: ChannelManifest
entities.definition: The Phase 0 probe's per-channel record of source, symbol, requested vs actual frequency, earliest and latest timestamp, missing fraction, timezone, timestamp semantics, and revision behavior; committed to the repo and consulted by every alignment run.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §4.1 'data/manifests/channel_coverage.json'; product-spec-v4.md §'Phase 0 data-availability probe'.

entities.name: AlignedRow
entities.definition: One row on the canonical 15-minute UTC grid produced by as-of joining every channel on `known_at`; carries every channel's value, missing_mask, age_since_known_at, and observed_at_this_grid_step for that timestamp.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §5 'one wide table on a canonical 15-minute UTC grid'.

entities.name: Feature
entities.definition: A causally computed per-bar value derived from RawObservation columns and AlignedRow context; every rolling window has `min_periods` and every label-adjacent column is `.shift(1)`-ed.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §6 'Every feature is computed with strictly causal utilities'.

entities.name: NormalizerState
entities.definition: The frozen expanding-window z-score parameters (mean, std, warmup mask) fitted on the training partition and persisted to `artifacts/{run_id}/normalizers.pt`; validation and test read the state as-is. Layer-0 seat for the Normalizer operator (Layer 6, populated Step 7).
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §6 'Normalization — one scheme, committed'; product-spec-v4.md §'Feature normalization'; reclassification rationale: reviews/vocab-0.1-layer-0-review.md finding 4.

entities.name: BucketStats
entities.definition: The frozen dequantizer file `artifacts/tokenizer/bucket_stats.json` — one entry per bucket carrying `bucket_lower`, `bucket_upper`, `bucket_train_mean`, `bucket_train_median`, `bucket_train_frequency`; the artifact every downstream consumer reads to convert a bucket id back to an expected return. Layer-0 seat for the Bucketizer operator (Layer 6, populated Step 7).
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §7.1; reclassification rationale: reviews/vocab-0.1-layer-0-review.md finding 4.

entities.name: MarketStateToken
entities.definition: One `d_model`-dimensional vector per bar produced by the Embedder operator (Layer 6, populated Step 7); the temporal transformer attends over the sequence of these.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §7.2 'the single d_model-vector the transformer treats as position t'.

entities.name: Window
entities.definition: A fixed-length slice of MarketStateTokens (context_len bars) with per-position targets and a per-position validity mask; the training loop's sampling unit.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §9.2 `PriceSpaceDataset`; product-spec-v4.md §'Training loss and windowing'.

entities.name: Model
entities.definition: A trainable network — one of PriceSpaceLLM, LinearBaseline, MLPBaseline, GRUBaseline, ChannelMixerVariant, PatchNVariant, QuantileHeadVariant, TargetOnlyVariant, MagnitudeWeightedVariant; distinguished at Layer 2 by a payload attribute `run_kind` on TrainingRun. Merge Baseline+Ablation→Model stamped 2026-08-09 via P-001; nine variants distinguished at Layer 2 by `run_kind`.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §8 (PriceSpaceLLM) + §10 (baselines and ablations); P-001 stamped accepted 2026-08-09.

entities.name: TrainingRun
entities.definition: A single training execution keyed by run_id; one row in `experiments/logbook.csv`, one directory `artifacts/{run_id}/`; carries ExperimentConfig, git SHA, data hash, seed, `run_kind`.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §5 (`data/aligned/{run_id}.parquet`), §12 (logbook row), §13 (SDD trace metadata).

entities.name: Checkpoint
entities.definition: A saved model state at a specific training step; contains model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG states, config, git SHA, data hash, step, val_metrics.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §9.3 'checkpoint {model, optimizer, scheduler, rng_states, config, git_sha, data_hash, step, val_metrics}'.

entities.name: Prediction
entities.definition: The model's output at a position — a probability distribution over V buckets — with derived scalars (expected_vn_return, expected_return, p_up, sharpness). Merge Distribution→Prediction stamped 2026-08-09 via P-002.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §11 'softmaxes to p[t] ∈ ℝ^V, then derives ...'.

entities.name: Metric
entities.definition: A named validation number reported per training run: NLL, ECE, Brier, RPS, directional accuracy, top-1/top-3 accuracy; NLL alone gates checkpoint selection.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §9.3 + §10 'Prediction metrics'; product-spec-v4.md §'Training infrastructure'.

entities.name: RegimeLabel
entities.definition: A VIX tercile tag (low / mid / high) attached to a held-out bar, computed on the training window and frozen; every held-out metric is reported per regime.
entities.source: product-spec-v4.md §'Regime evaluation'; tech-arch-v4.md §10 'Regime-conditional evaluation'.

entities.name: CostCalibration
entities.definition: The paired fit of the Corwin-Schultz→BBO spread scaler and the OLS slippage coefficient with heteroskedasticity-robust SEs; persisted to `artifacts/cost_calibration/{spread_scaler,kappa}.json`; required at simulator startup as one precondition. Merge SpreadCalibration+KappaCalibration→CostCalibration stamped 2026-08-09 via P-003.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §11.1 + §11.2.

entities.name: Decision
entities.definition: The simulator's per-bar output — long, short, or flat, plus a size — computed from `edge = expected_return − spread_cost − kappa·size − lambda_risk·variance(p)` against a threshold and hysteresis.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §11.4 'Decision rule'.

entities.name: Position
entities.definition: The currently held single-instrument state at a bar; the simulator holds at most one at a time and drops same-direction re-entries.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §11.4 'The simulator holds a single position at a time'.

entities.name: Trade
entities.definition: A paired entry+exit position lifecycle; the unit reported in the per-trade P&L histogram and the hit-rate calculation.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §11.5 'per-trade P&L histogram with tail metrics'.

entities.name: SimResult
entities.definition: A simulator run's output — trade ledger, equity curve, per-bar decisions, per-regime metrics — JSON-serializable and written to the logbook.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §15 'SimResult dataclass: trade ledger, equity curve, per-bar decisions, per-regime metrics'.

entities.name: TestLook
entities.definition: One authorized use of the held-out 2024-01 through 2025-06 window; one line in `experiments/test_looks.log`; budget of three for the whole v1 enforced by a pre-commit hook.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §13 'Structural enforcement of the 3-look budget'; product-spec-v4.md §'Success gates for v1'.

entities.name: Bucket
entities.definition: One of V discrete return classes (V ∈ {16, 32, 64}); one row of BucketStats; outer buckets 0 and V-1 have infinite outer edges.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §7.1 'bucket 0 catches everything below the 0.5th percentile; bucket 31 catches everything above the 99.5th'.

entities.name: MetricSnapshot
entities.definition: The JSON file `artifacts/{run_id}/metrics.json` capturing a TrainingRun's final metrics at fixed keys with value ranges; usable as a regression fixture.
entities.source: TECHNIQUES.md §2 Data science 'Metric snapshot as artifact' — kit-pattern adoption stamped explicitly per reviews/vocab-0.1-round-3-review.md finding 6.

entities.name: Split
entities.definition: A named contiguous date range that partitions bars into train / validation / test; the load-bearing evaluation-side noun that the embargo of H bars and the test-look budget both guard.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md invariant #2 'Time-based splits with embargo'; §9.2 `build_split_mask(...)`; product-spec-v4.md §'Training range'.

entities.name: Session
entities.definition: One regular-trading-hours span for the target instrument — the 26-bar interior between two SessionBoundary edges — with persistent attributes session_date, is_rth, regime_label. Dually classed at Layer 0 (entity) and Layer 3 (session stratum, framed by TRADING_SESSION_STARTED / TRADING_SESSION_ENDED). Step 4 re-encounters as a session-stratum entry; does not re-propose as new entity.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §5 'each session yields 26 bars'; §6 'Session-boundary handling'; §9.3 diagnostic timestamps. Dual-class note per reviews/vocab-0.1-round-3-review.md finding 6.
entities.stamped: 2026-08-09, Architect inline (Layer 0 + Layer 3 dual class ratified)

entities.name: ExperimentConfig
entities.definition: A resolved YAML validated by Pydantic v2 at load time — a first-class artifact with a validator at the speaker's mouth. One config seeds one or more TrainingRuns via distinct seeds; TrainingRun carries a foreign-key reference `config_hash` to the ExperimentConfig.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §11.3 'A run without an explicit lambda_risk in its resolved config fails registration'; §12 (Hydra + Pydantic v2). Standalone (one-to-many with TrainingRun) confirmed at inline stamp per reviews/vocab-0.1-round-3-review.md finding 6.

entities.name: Source
entities.definition: The vendor an IngestionCall targets — `mcp_av` (Alpha-Vantage-style MCP) or `polygon` (fallback for 15-min equity bars); recorded as the `source` field on every RawObservation and ChannelManifest entry. Runtime-grammar anchor for the fallback chain.
entities.source: tech-arch-v4.md §4.2 `IngestionClient(source=Literal['mcp_av','polygon'])`; §4.1 ChannelManifest 'source' key. Runtime-grammar rationale per reviews/vocab-0.1-layer-0-review.md finding 3.

operators._layer: Layer 6 — Runtime / Operator. 24 operators named. Fulfills the P-015 domain-vs-runtime commitment from BLACKBOARD § Deferred: IngestionClient, AlignmentJoin, SourceFallback, TrainingLoop, Simulator plus the reclassified Embedder / Bucketizer / Normalizer + their Layer-0 seat crossrefs, plus additional operators found by walking tech-arch's module layout (PhaseZeroProbe, ChannelFetcher, FeaturePipeline, PriceSpaceLLM, BaselineModel, PriceSpaceDataset, Evaluator, CostCalibrator, SimulatorPolicy, SimulatorCostModel, ConfigResolver, ExperimentLogbook, TestLookGuard, TrainerReporter, ChannelMixerEmbedder).

operators.name: ProcessRunner
operators.responsibility: The main entrypoint of every script (probe_channels, align, train, evaluate, simulate, calibrate_spread, calibrate_kappa, register_run). Emits SESSION_INIT as the first signal of the capture, wraps the run's work, catches exceptions, emits SESSION_COMPLETE as the last signal with exit_code and elapsed_seconds. Sets the process_session bounds every downstream operator emits within.
operators.source: sdd-kit-2/foundations/01 SESSION_INIT pattern + example/wordcount main() precedent + tech-arch-v4.md §3 scripts/ layout

operators.name: PhaseZeroProbe
operators.responsibility: Walks channels_v1.yaml, hits each Source at five sample dates, records what the vendor actually returned; writes data/manifests/channel_coverage.json. Runs before any pipeline stage.

operators.name: IngestionClient
operators.responsibility: Thin façade over vendor Sources. Token-bucket rate limiter, retry-with-backoff on 429/5xx, response validation, Parquet caching keyed by sha256(tool, params). Manages source fallback.

operators.name: SourceFallback
operators.responsibility: Detects primary-source failure modes (frequency_unavailable, history_gap, rate_limit_exhausted, response_invalid); switches subsequent calls for the (channel, symbol) to the secondary Source.
operators.source: tech-arch-v4.md §4.2 'Fallback is Polygon.io for equities minute bars when the MCP falls short'

operators.name: ChannelFetcher
operators.responsibility: Per-channel adapter implementing fetch(symbol, start, end, freq) → DataFrame. Requests 15-min where the vendor supports it; downsamples to 15-min otherwise. Writes RawObservation rows carrying value_time, released_at, known_at, revision_id.

operators.name: AlignmentJoin
operators.responsibility: Polars join_asof on known_at against the 15-min UTC grid. Selects the most recent row per channel satisfying known_at ≤ t; picks the latest revision. Writes data/aligned/{run_id}.parquet with missing_mask, age_since_known_at, observed_at_this_grid_step columns.
operators.performance_constraint: Polars join_asof ~1s on the aligned dataset per tech-arch §17

operators.name: FeaturePipeline
operators.responsibility: Computes per-bar causal features from AlignedRow context. Rolling windows have min_periods; label-adjacent columns are .shift(1)-ed. Emits per (feature_name, channel, timestamp).

operators.name: CausalNormalizer
operators.responsibility: Expanding-window causal z-scorer. Fits on training partition only, freezes at end of training. Writes artifacts/{run_id}/normalizers.pt.

operators.name: ReturnBucketizer
operators.responsibility: Discretizes vol-normalized returns into V ∈ {16, 32, 64} buckets, percentile-uniform in the interior with outer tails. Fits on training only; writes artifacts/tokenizer/bucket_stats.json (frozen dequantizer).

operators.name: MarketStateEmbedder
operators.responsibility: Per-channel nn.Linear projections, summed to one d_model vector per bar. No channel-type embedding inside the sum (v4 removal). Layer-0 output is MarketStateToken.
operators.layer_0_seat: MarketStateToken (Layer 0 entity — runtime output, not frozen file)

operators.name: ChannelMixerEmbedder
operators.responsibility: Ablation variant. Per-channel projections + one-block cross-channel attention block before temporal transformer. Parameter-matched to MarketStateEmbedder.

operators.name: PriceSpaceLLM
operators.responsibility: Causal decoder over MarketStateToken sequence. RoPE, pre-LN, GELU, causal SDPA. Head projects to V-bucket logits at every position.
operators.model_route: one of xs (1M) / sm (3M) / md (10M) / lg (30M) per size sweep
operators.performance_constraint: bf16 mixed precision; batch fills GPU memory

operators.name: BaselineModel
operators.responsibility: One of LinearBaseline, MLPBaseline, GRUBaseline (~1M each) — the ladder isolating depth / same-state nonlinearity / basic temporal modeling. Same input tokens, same targets, same seeds.
operators.model_route: run_kind = train with variant discriminator (linear / mlp / gru / tcn)

operators.name: PriceSpaceDataset
operators.responsibility: mmaps data/tokenized/{run_id}.pt. Random-window sampling: uniform over valid starts per draw. build_split_mask enforces date range and embargo. Yields (feats: dict, target, mask) triples of length context_len.

operators.name: TrainingLoop
operators.responsibility: All-position cross-entropy loss (every valid position predicts next bucket). Optional magnitude-weighted variant via alpha in config. AdamW, cosine LR with warmup, gradient clip at 1.0. bf16 autocast.
operators.performance_constraint: single A10 or A100; ~$500 v1 budget covers all sweeps + ablations

operators.name: Evaluator
operators.responsibility: Per-step, per-eval, and per-run metric computation. Cross-entropy at every valid position averaged over val partition. Regime split with frozen VIX terciles. Writes artifacts/{run_id}/metrics.json.

operators.name: CostCalibrator
operators.responsibility: Two fits, one script pair. calibrate_spread.py regresses Corwin-Schultz proxy against measured BBO on the training window; calibrate_kappa.py OLS for slippage with heteroskedasticity-robust SEs. Writes artifacts/cost_calibration/{spread_scaler,kappa}.json.

artifacts: BBO snapshots (30-day window in training range)

operators.name: Simulator
operators.responsibility: Bar-by-bar walker over the test range. Reads a Checkpoint and a CostCalibration; hosts SimulatorPolicy and SimulatorCostModel; iterates trading sessions and per-bar decisions. Fills at next bar's open. Writes SimResult.

operators.name: SimulatorPolicy
operators.responsibility: Decision rule: edge = expected_return − spread_cost − kappa·size − lambda_risk·variance(p). Long if edge > threshold, short if < −threshold, else flat. Size = clip(edge / uncertainty_scale, ±max_size). Same-direction re-entries dropped; opposite flips need > threshold·(1+hysteresis).

operators.name: SimulatorCostModel
operators.responsibility: spread_cost = 0.5 · calibrated_spread_t; slippage = kappa · size. Reads CostCalibration artifacts at simulator startup; refuses to run if files missing.

operators.name: ConfigResolver
operators.responsibility: Hydra composition + Pydantic v2 validation at load. Composes YAML groups (target, data, features, tokenizer, model, training, simulation). lambda_risk must be present; missing fails registration.

operators.name: ExperimentLogbook
operators.responsibility: Writes one row per training run to experiments/logbook.csv. Includes run_id, git_sha, config_hash, data_hash, all val metrics, held-out Sharpe if any, touched_test boolean.

artifacts: SDD trace run metadata via register_run.py

operators.name: TestLookGuard
operators.responsibility: Two-part enforcement. Runtime: scripts/simulate.py and scripts/evaluate.py refuse to touch held-out data if experiments/test_looks.log already lists three lines for this vocabulary version. Pre-commit: scripts/check_test_look.sh fails commits whose changed configs contain dates ≥ 2024-01-01 without the literal [test-look] token.
